title: Full Stack Software Developer
description: Our customer based in Türkiye is seeking a Full Stack Software Developer to join a growing technology and engineering organisation delivering innovative software, AI and digital transformation projects. The Full Stack Software Developer is responsible for the design, development, testing and support of modern web-based applications, SaaS platforms and digital business solutions. The role involves working across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and system design through to deployment, maintenance and continuous improvement, delivering secure, scalable and user-focused solutions. Design, develop and maintain front-end and back-end software applications Build responsive user interfaces using modern web development technologies Develop APIs, web services and third-party integrations Design, implement and maintain relational and non-relational databases Participate in software architecture and technical design activities Conduct software testing, debugging and performance optimisation Support deployment, release management and production support activities Create and maintain technical documentation Work collaboratively within Agile development environments Contribute to continuous improvement and software quality initiatives Requirements Essential Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline. Experience with TypeScript and React. Experience using Node.js, ASP.NET or equivalent back-end frameworks. Strong SQL and database knowledge. Understanding of API development and cloud-based architectures. Knowledge of software development lifecycle methodologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Professional working proficiency in English is required. Preferred Qualifications And Experience Docker and containerisation experience. CI/CD pipeline experience. Cloud deployment experience within Azure, AWS or Google Cloud. Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices. Experience developing enterprise, manufacturing or SaaS software solutions.

title: Backend Chapter Lead (Collection)
description: Design the future architecture of one of Europe's most innovative banking networks while empowering engineers to do their best work. At ING Hubs Türkiye, we're looking for a Backend Chapter Lead to join our Retail Banking / Collection domain , combining strong backend engineering expertise with people leadership capabilities. You'll provide technical leadership, guide engineers through complex backend solutions, and lead a chapter of talented engineers through coaching, mentoring, and capability development. The solutions you and your teams build will support critical Retail Banking and Collections journeys across ING's international banking ecosystem. Role Summary As a Backend Chapter Lead, you will play a dual role combining Backend Engineering Leadership with People Leadership responsibilities . You will work closely with Product Owners, Architects, Engineering Leads, and business stakeholders to design and deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable backend solutions. Work Model At ING Hubs Türkiye, flexibility is more than a benefit—it's part of how we work. Our hybrid way of working is designed to balance collaboration, innovation, and personal flexibility. Team members typically come together at our Vadistanbul office for two days per week during three weeks of the month, while one week each month is fully remote. We also provide additional flexibility throughout August with remote working opportunities, allowing colleagues to remain productive while staying connected with their teams. As part of a globally distributed organization, you'll collaborate with colleagues across multiple ING locations and contribute to solutions used across the bank. About the Team You will join an international technology organization where ownership, knowledge sharing, collaboration, and engineering excellence are at the heart of everything we do. Our teams design and deliver critical technology platforms that support ING's digital transformation journey. We believe scalable architectures, strong engineering practices, automation, and continuous learning are essential for delivering reliable solutions at scale. About You We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you'll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we'll support your growth into an even more awesome version of yourself. Minimum Qualifications 8+ years of experience in software engineering or backend development Strong experience with Java and Spring Boot Experience as a Senior Java Engineer, Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or similar role Proven experience leading, coaching, or mentoring engineers Experience with scalable distributed systems and microservices Strong stakeholder management and communication skills Experience working in Agile organizations Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline Fluent English communication skills (C1 level or above) We are looking for leaders who can: Define end-to-end solution architectures across multiple systems and domains Lead feasibility studies and solution assessments for new initiatives Drive modernization and cloud transformation programs Define integration strategies, architectural standards, and design patterns Promote scalable, secure, and maintainable technology solutions Support platform evolution and technology roadmap planning Guide teams through architectural decision-making processes Bridge business goals and technology execution Chapter Leadership Responsibilities Beyond architecture, you'll be responsible for growing and developing a chapter of engineers. You will: Manage and coach a chapter of approximately 8–12 engineers Support capability development and career growth discussions Conduct regular one-on-one meetings and performance evaluations Drive hiring, onboarding, and team expansion activities Foster engineering excellence and continuous learning culture Coach engineers on architecture, design patterns, and software craftsmanship Support succession planning and talent development initiatives Promote collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams Technology & Engineering Expertise Hands-on technical understanding remains essential for this role. Backend Technologies Java and J2EE platforms Spring Framework and Spring Boot REST and SOAP Services JPA and Hibernate Unit and Integration Testing Test Driven Development (TDD) Architecture & Integration Microservices Architecture Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Event-Driven Architecture Enterprise Integration Patterns UML and Architecture Modelling API-First Design Cloud & Platform Engineering Azure Cloud Services Azure DevOps CI/CD Pipelines Container Platforms Docker Kubernetes and/or OpenShift Platform Modernization Data & Development Tools Git Oracle Database SQL and PL/SQL Source Control and Release Management Software Delivery Lifecycle Tooling Messaging & Distributed Systems Experience with technologies such as: Kafka JMS ActiveMQ IBM MQ Enterprise Messaging Platforms Equal Opportunity Don't meet every single requirement? Don't let that hold you back. Studies show many talented professionals hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. What We Offer at ING Hubs Türkiye At ING Hubs Türkiye, we believe that your work should be fulfilling in every way. We pay attention to even the smallest details to ensure that your experience is rewarding. Be Yourself, Be an ING'er Welcome Leave: Enjoy 14 days of welcome leave, even in your first year Self-driven career opportunities Challenging projects and continuous learning opportunities Flexible hybrid working model Remote working opportunities throughout August Training budget and Udemy partnership Global mobility and international career opportunities Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family Private Pension Plan Meal Card Transportation Allowance MultiSport Membership English Language Development Support Innovation culture powered by PACE methodology Regular communication activities and celebrations About ING With 65,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what's possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer's interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.

title: Associate Backend Developer
description: Migros’ta İyi Geleceği Birlikte Tasarlayalım! 🧡 Hayat bir alışveriş bizim için, mutluluk alıp, mutluluk verdiğimiz... Raflarımız ödül ve başarılarla dolu… 20 yıldır “Türkiye’nin En Beğenilen Perakende Şirketi” seçilmek, Türkiye’nin ilk sadakat programını yaratmak, Türk perakende müşterisini kasiyersiz kasa ile tanıştırmak, Perakende sektöründe ilk AR-GE merkezini kurmak başarılarımızdan sadece birkaç tanesidir. Migroslular olarak biz, Perakendenin geçmişine ve geleceğine çok meraklıyız! Türkiye’de modern perakende sektörünün öncüsü olarak, 1954’ten bu yana bizim işimiz, iyi geleceği tasarlamaktır! Her Migroslu’nun kendi kariyer hikayesini yaratmasına fırsat sağladığımız “İyi Gelecek Yolculuğumuzun” bir parçası olmak isterseniz, başvurunuzu bekliyoruz! Migros’ta Bizler; 😊 Yaptığımız her işte mutluluk yaratırız. 🤝 Kendimize güvenir, Karşımızdakine güven verir ve güven duyarız. 🌿👫 Hassas noktamız doğa ve insandır. 🌟 İyi geleceğe öncülük ederiz. 🏆 Potansiyeli aşarız büyük başarılar yaşarız. 🚀 İyi fikirler geliştirir "yok artık" denilen fikirlere "var artık" deriz. Sizde Aradığımız Özellikler Neler? Tercihen üniversitelerin Matematik, Bilgisayar, Yazılım Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Java programlama dili ile 3-4 yıl profesyonel yazılım geliştirme konusunda deneyimli, Spring ve Spring Boot frameworklerini kullanarak uygulama geliştirmiş, ElasticSearch, MongoDB vb. NoSQL veritabanları teknolojilerini kullanmış, MySQL, PostgreSQL vb. ilişkisel veritabanlarını kullanma konusunda deneyimli, Kafka, RabbitMQ gibi dağıtık mesajlaşma sistemleri konusunda tecrübeli, Redis, Memcached vb. cache yapılarını deneyimlemiş, Docker ve Kubernetes gibi container ve orchestration araçlarını kullanabilen, Mikroservis mimarisi ve event sourcing konularında bilgi sahibi, Yeni teknolojileri takip eden ve geliştirme ortamına entegre edebilen, Agile/Scrum metodolojileri hakkında bilgili, Güçlü iletişim ve iş birliği becerilerine sahip, Problem çözme ve analitik düşünme yetkinliği gelişmiş, Süreç yönetimi ve organizasyon becerileri güçlü. Aramıza Katıldığınızda Neler Yapacaksınız? Bilgi Teknolojileri ve İş Geliştirme Direktörlüğü'ne bağlı Dönüşüm Ofisi "Lojistik Çözümleri" ekibinde; Dönüşüm sürecinde yeniden tasarlanacak tüm sistemlerin mimari tasarımlarında görev almak, Karşılaşılan farklı problemlere çözüm üretme konusunda ekip ile birlikte çalışmak, Backend tarafındaki web servislerinin geliştirilmesinden sorumlu olmak, Backend tarafındaki uygulama geliştirmelerinden sorumlu olmak. Yetenek Kazanımı Sürecimiz Nasıl İlerleyecek? Özgeçmiş ön değerlendirme süreci İnsan Kaynakları Görüşmesi Değerlendirme Testleri Birim Görüşmesi Referans Araştırması Teklif Süreci 🤞🏻 *Görüşülen pozisyonun niteliğine göre süreç adımlarında değişiklik gerçekleşebilir. 📲Sosyal Medya kanallarında iş fırsatlarımızı takip etmeye devam edebilirsiniz. #Migros #İyiİşİyiGelecek *Sürdürülebilir büyüme, eşit imkanlar ve farklı bakış açılarıyla mümkündür. Lead Network Europe (NPO)’nun Gold Partneri olarak; İnsan Hakları ve Fırsat Eşitliği politikamız doğrultusunda, Migros’ta herkesin şeffaf, adil ve eşit haklara sahip olması gerektiğine inanıyor ve çalışıyoruz.

title: Senior Backend Developer (Node.js)
description: Who We Are At Mobiversite, we don’t just build apps — we craft digital experiences used by millions of people worldwide. Our products combine creativity, technology, and data to create scalable, high-impact digital solutions. We’re looking for an experienced Senior Backend Developer (Node.js) who is passionate about building reliable backend systems and scalable services that power high-volume mobile and web applications. What You’ll Do Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable backend systems using Node.js. Collaborate closely with frontend and mobile teams to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic. Build, maintain, and optimize RESTful APIs and backend services . Ensure high performance, availability, and scalability of applications. Design and manage database schemas and data models , working with both SQL and NoSQL databases. Monitor, troubleshoot, and debug backend systems to ensure smooth operation. Contribute to architectural decisions and continuously improve backend infrastructure and code quality. What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering , or a related field. 5+ years of hands-on experience developing backend systems using Node.js. Strong expertise in Node.js, Express.js , and modern backend frameworks. Solid understanding of REST API design and development . Experience with PostgreSQL, and/or MySQL . Familiarity with cloud infrastructure , preferably AWS . Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and asynchronous programming patterns. Understanding of software engineering best practices, including clean code, OOP principles, and design patterns . Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. What We Offer Competitive Salary: A compensation package that’s aligned with the market and your experience Top-Line Equipment: Latest MacBooks, plus all the accessories and software you need to succeed in your role Company-supported healthcare package: We go above and beyond when it comes to your health Celebrations: Special birthday coupons to celebrate you Transportation Allowance: Monthly commute support Meal Allowance: Monthly meal support Monthly Motivation Package: A dedicated budget to keep you inspired and energized Salary Reviews: Twice a year Performance Bonus: Rewarding impact and results

title: Fullstack Developer (.Net&React)
description: We are looking for a talented Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience to join our engineering team. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of modern, scalable applications, collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, and help deliver high-quality software solutions using .NET and React . Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable applications using .NET and React. Build and optimize RESTful APIs and backend services. Develop reusable, high-performance frontend components. Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following SOLID principles and design patterns. Optimize SQL queries and improve database performance. Participate in code reviews and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Write unit and integration tests to ensure software quality. Continuously evaluate and adopt appropriate technologies and best practices. Requirements 4+ years of professional experience with .NET / C# and ASP.NET Core. Strong experience with React, including component architecture, state management, and performance optimization. Experience designing layered architectures and RESTful APIs. Strong SQL skills, including query tuning, execution plan analysis, and indexing strategies. Solid understanding of SOLID, Design Patterns, and Clean Code principles. Experience writing Unit and Integration Tests. Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows. Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills. Passion for learning new technologies and delivering high-quality software. If you're passionate about building high-quality software, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and want to work with modern technologies in a collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of our growing engineering team! Amaris Consulting is committed to promoting diversity within its workforce and to creating an inclusive work environment. We review applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic. Special consideration will be given to candidates with disabilities.
